glossEn: material produced by or used in a reaction involving changes in atoms or molecules
note: material produced by or used in a reaction involving changes in the chemical constitution。名词义，指「物」。线索：toxic chemicals / agricultural chemicals。

glossEn: relating to or used in chemistry / of or made from or using substances produced by or used in reactions involving atomic or molecular changes
note: relating to or used in chemistry / of or made from or using substances produced by or used in reactions。形容词义。两条边界英文有别（涉及化学 vs 由化学品制成），中文统一译「化学的」，看不出差别，合并。线索：chemical industry / chemical weapons。
